properties.name: ROOT CAUSE (walked, measured on 0.77.0): coverage_report compares each observed path with every Artifact location as a literal string, normalising only "./" and backslashes (core coverage.rs normalise and claims). A design that registers commit-pinned URLs therefore claims 0 files for a repo-relative sweep. That is a third meaning of "artifact location", beside the one the server and the CI gate were given in common (measure.rs is_uri), and the change that unified those two never reached coverage. Separately, string entries in `observed` get a bare deserialize error that names neither the tool nor the field
properties.statement:
RUN AS THE SKILL (root-cause, fetched fresh), 2026-10-02, triage agent B. Tool friction "coverage_report wants `{path}` records, not strings; kind-2 designs that register commit-pinned URLs need the same URL form in the sweep or report 0 files claimed" in art:vscode-call-door-field-report-2026-10-02.

① OBSERVED, both halves reproduced through `--call` on scratch stores.
(a) `coverage_report {"observed":["src/a.rs"]}` exits 2 with "failed to deserialize parameters: invalid type: string \"src/a.rs\", expected a map". The published schema's `observed` description gives the `{ "path": ..., "mass": ... }` shape, so the shape is published and the door did not show it (fact:root-cause-argument-shapes-are-learned-by-refusal-because-the-door-holds-the-full-schema-and-prints-none-of-it-2026-10-02). The refusal itself is the bare-deserialize class that the report's idea 15 / `refusal_speaks` names; that is another triage slice.
(b) One Artifact with location "https://github.com/org/repo/blob/0123abc/src/a.rs":
- a sweep of {path:"src/a.rs"} gives claimed 0, unclaimed 1, and unobserved_locations [the URL];
- a sweep of {path: the same URL} gives claimed 1.

② PRECEDENT:
- chg:a-remote-located-artifact-is-not-a-missing-file taught the CI gate that a URI location is "present, not judged".
- chg:the-server-and-the-gate-share-one-meaning-for-an-artifact-location moved that meaning into the server (crates/reflow2-mcp/src/measure.rs is_uri).
- fact:root-cause-a-location-is-anchored-to-a-root-the-design-never-records-2026-09-28 records that a location's root is implicit.

⑤ CAUSE IN CODE (origin/main 66620f7): crates/reflow2-core/src/coverage.rs normalise() strips only "./" and turns "\\" into "/", and claims() is equality or a "claim/" prefix. It does not call is_uri, and it has no remote state. So coverage neither strips a commit-pinned prefix nor says "N locations are remote and could not be matched". The only hint is the URL listed in unobserved_locations.

⑥ CLASS: what a location means is decided in more than one place by hand. The unification fixed two instruments and left this third one. A fix that only accepted URL-form sweeps would not stop the next reader.

NOT ESTABLISHED: what "kind-2 design" means in the reporter's vocabulary. It is taken here as a design whose Artifacts point at code in another repository by commit-pinned URL.
